in_hebrew.name: Elettra
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Goddess of the East
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Elettra הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Greek mythology, Elettra is the goddess of the dawn and the east wind. She is the daughter of Helios, the god of the sun, and is often depicted carrying a torch or a crown of rays.

in_greek.long_meaning: bright, amber (from the Greek word for amber, ήλεκτρον)
